context: Tests whether a suite prune removes low-value cases with named keepers, deletes the test-only seam with its test, retains contract checks that look like junk, and treats a failing baseline test as a defect rather than a deletion.

checklist.name: Duplicate layer removed with keeper
checklist.description: The client tests that only replay seconds parsing (5 and 30 second delays) are removed or consolidated, and the response names the parseRetryAfter tests or the retained 429 client test as the keeper

checklist.name: Weak and cloned cases removed
checklist.description: The typeof number check and the seconds-for-30 clone are deleted or folded into an existing case instead of kept as separate tests

checklist.name: Test-only seam deleted
checklist.description: The cache-reset test is removed together with the __resetCacheForTests export, or the export is replaced by isolation that needs no production seam; no test-only export remains only for tests

checklist.name: Contract look-alikes retained
checklist.description: The retry-after header name assertion, the HTTP date case, and the 429 retry client test survive because they guard protocol and integration contracts

checklist.name: Baseline failure reported as a defect
checklist.description: The failing negative-delay test is kept with its expectation intact and reported as a real parseRetryAfter defect; it is not deleted, skipped, or rewritten to expect -5000

checklist.name: Coverage evidence honest
checklist.description: The response reports before and after test counts and line coverage measured with the package's coverage command, or names the command that failed and marks coverage unverified; it never claims coverage stayed within 2 points without a run

checklist.name: Target not forced
checklist.description: Removal stops at clearly low-value cases; no real contract loses its only proof to reach the 50% target, and src behavior other than the removed test-only seam is unchanged
